input.summary: Invoice PI26-2809 from Pinecone Collaboration Ltd. (CAD 868.14, dated 2026-11-02) is on hold because its subtotal of CAD 826.80 is above the fixed monthly fee of CAD 780.00 in contract C003. The contract is active until 2026-12-31 and has no fuel surcharge cap. Earlier invoices were CAD 819.00 or CAD 868.14, and the same CAD 868.14 total was settled for PI26-2803 and PI26-2800, so the overcharge may have happened before. No approvals are recorded on this invoice.
open_questions: Is the extra amount above CAD 780.00 a legitimate add-on, such as extra licences, or an error?
Were the settled invoices PI26-2803 and PI26-2800 overpaid against the fixed fee?
